name: io.github.tiranyx/rupa3d
title: Rupa3D
description: Checks GLB assets against a spec without Blender and embeds the measured proof inside the GLB.

environmentVariables.name: RUPA3D_BLENDER
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Blender executable. Only the Blender-backed tools need it; GLB checking, CAD and scenes run without Blender.

environmentVariables.name: RUPA3D_RUANG
environmentVariables.description: Workspace directory for scenes and CAD shapes. Default: ~/.rupa3d
